pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with rounded vertices and soft pixel-level edge gradients. The patches vary in size, with those on the upper neck appearing more vertically elongated compared to the more equiaxial patches on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected negative-space graph composed of light-toned pathways. The topology features numerous tri-node and quad-node junctions. Continuity is maintained throughout the visible region, with pathway thickness remaining relatively uniform.
